sonnet.problem: Story card 9 introduces the herd of pigs right before the choice. The baker then sees 'the pigs' as the only answer tied to what was just told, and the other two answers (stay in the tombs, go to the desert) look out of place. The setup gives away the answer.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later. ... A setup line can't rule out the wrong answers either.
